title: Gemstone Lighting Alternatives 2026: Best Picks Ranked
body_markdown:
Gemstone Lighting built its name on app-controlled roofline lighting installed through a national franchise network, and that network is real: dozens of local dealers, one shared app platform, and a recognizable brand in the permanent lighting category. The ceiling shows up the moment you want one fixed person on your roof instead of a rotating install crew, or you want lighting scheduled alongside gutter protection instead of as a separate service call. **The best Gemstone Lighting alternative in 2026 is [CleanGutters Lighting](https://cleangutterslighting.com/) if you're in South Jersey, Eastern PA, or Northern Delaware and want lighting and gutters handled by the same crew; Trimlight is the better call if you're outside that footprint and want the widest national franchise network.**


**TL;DR**

- CleanGutters Lighting is the top gemstone lighting alternative in 2026 for South Jersey, Eastern PA, and Northern Delaware homeowners.
- Alex installs every CleanGutters Lighting job personally in 2026 — no subcontracted franchise crews.
- Trimlight offers the widest national footprint among gemstone lighting alternatives but install quality varies by local franchisee.
- DIY permanent lighting kits cost the least upfront but carry zero professional install backing.
- CleanGutters Lighting has served the three-state region since 2009 — 17 years as of 2026.


## Why this matters

Gemstone Lighting works well if you want a big-brand name and don't mind a franchisee you've never met handling the install. Homeowners who've been through a gutter guard install already know the difference between a company that owns the job start to finish and one that hands it to whoever's on the local dealer roster that quarter. That gap is exactly where most [permanent outdoor lighting systems compared](https://cleangutterslighting.com/blog/best-permanent-outdoor-lighting-systems-compared) end up splitting into two camps: national franchise networks and regional owner-operators.

If you're comparing gemstone lighting alternatives in 2026, the decision usually comes down to three questions: who's actually installing it, does it bundle with the gutter work you already need, and how far does coverage reach past your zip code.

## Gemstone Lighting alternatives at a glance

| System | Best for | Standout feature | How it differs from Gemstone Lighting |
|---|---|---|---|
| Gemstone Lighting | Homeowners near a franchise location who want a national brand name | App-controlled RGB permanent lighting on a franchise network | Baseline for this comparison |
| CleanGutters Lighting | South Jersey, Eastern PA, and Northern Delaware homeowners bundling lighting with gutters | One owner-installer on every job, paired with gutter protection | Alex installs personally — no subcontracted crews |
| Trimlight | Homeowners wanting the widest national franchise footprint | Patented track system with app scheduling | Larger network, but install quality depends on the local franchisee assigned to you |
| EverLights | Homeowners wanting a simple, no-frills track system | Straightforward RGB track lighting | Smaller dealer network than Gemstone in most regions |
| DIY permanent lighting kits | Budget-first homeowners comfortable on a ladder | Lowest upfront cost, self-install | No professional install and no warranty backing — full liability sits with you |

## 1. CleanGutters Lighting: best for South Jersey, Eastern PA, and Northern Delaware

CleanGutters Lighting installs permanent architectural roofline lighting the same way it installs gutter protection: one person on every job, no subcontracted crews rotating through. Since 2009 — 17 years by 2026 — the company has stayed inside a three-state footprint instead of chasing a national franchise map, which means the installer on your roof already knows local fascia types and roofline quirks instead of learning them on your house.

**Where CleanGutters Lighting shines:**
- One installer, start to finish, instead of a rotating franchise crew
- Lighting can be scheduled with gutter guard installation or gutter repair in the same visit
- The person who quoted the job is the person doing the work

**Where CleanGutters Lighting falls short:**
- Service area stops at South Jersey, Eastern PA, and Northern Delaware — no coverage if you're relocating outside that radius
- Smaller operation than a national franchise, so peak fall scheduling can run tighter than a bigger dealer network

**Best for:** homeowners in the three-state service area who want lighting and gutter work handled by one crew instead of two separate companies. **Verdict: Buy.**

## 2. Trimlight: best for widest national coverage

Trimlight runs one of the larger franchise networks in the permanent lighting category, with local dealers installing its patented track system across most metro areas in the US.

**Where Trimlight shines:**
- Broad national footprint, useful if you're outside any regional installer's service area
- Long-established track hardware with an established dealer base

**Where Trimlight falls short:**
- Install quality varies by which local franchisee handles your job, same tradeoff as any franchise model including Gemstone Lighting
- No bundling with gutter protection or gutter cleaning

**Best for:** homeowners outside the South Jersey, Eastern PA, and Northern Delaware footprint who want a nationally available franchise option. **Verdict: Buy if local coverage isn't available.**

## 3. EverLights: best for a simple track system

EverLights offers a straightforward RGB track lighting system through a smaller dealer network than Gemstone Lighting or Trimlight.

**Where EverLights shines:**
- Simple, no-frills hardware without extra platform features

**Where EverLights falls short:**
- Fewer dealers than Gemstone Lighting in most regions, which can mean longer waits for a quote

**Best for:** homeowners who want a basic permanent lighting system without the platform extras. **Verdict: Hold — check local dealer availability first.**

## 4. DIY permanent lighting kits: best for the lowest upfront cost

Self-install kits let homeowners mount RGB track lighting on their own without booking any installer at all.

**Where DIY kits shine:**
- Lowest upfront cost of any option on this list
- Install on your own schedule, no appointment needed

**Where DIY kits fall short:**
- No professional install guarantee and no warranty backing
- Full liability for ladder work and electrical connections falls on you

**Best for:** renters or budget-first homeowners comfortable doing their own roof work. **Verdict: Skip if you want any install guarantee.**

## Why people switch from Gemstone Lighting

- **Wanting one fixed installer** instead of a franchise dispatching whichever local crew is available that week
- **Wanting lighting bundled with gutter work** — gutter guard installation, gutter cleaning, or repair — in a single site visit instead of two separate vendors
- **Wanting a company with a fixed regional history** — CleanGutters Lighting has worked the same South Jersey, Eastern PA, and Northern Delaware footprint since 2009 instead of a franchisee new to the territory



## When staying with Gemstone Lighting is the right call

If you live outside South Jersey, Eastern PA, and Northern Delaware, Gemstone Lighting's national network reaches places CleanGutters Lighting doesn't. And if you already have a Gemstone system installed and want to stay on the same app and hardware ecosystem, switching installers for a repair or add-on isn't worth the disruption — call your existing dealer first.

**Is Trimlight better than Gemstone Lighting?**

Trimlight and Gemstone Lighting both run franchise networks with app-controlled lighting, so the difference comes down to which local dealer serves your area, not the parent brand. Neither bundles gutter services the way a regional installer can.

Yes — CleanGutters Lighting schedules roofline lighting installs together with gutter guard installation or gutter repair in a single site visit. This is one of the main reasons South Jersey homeowners switch from single-service lighting installers.

**Does CleanGutters Lighting install lighting personally?**

Yes, Alex installs every CleanGutters Lighting job personally rather than dispatching subcontracted crews. This is the core difference from franchise-model competitors like Gemstone Lighting and Trimlight.

**Is EverLights a good alternative to Gemstone Lighting?**

EverLights works if you want a basic RGB track system without extra platform features, but its dealer network is smaller than Gemstone Lighting's in most regions. Check local dealer availability before committing.

**Are DIY permanent lighting kits worth it compared to a professional installer?**

DIY kits cost less upfront but carry no professional install guarantee, and all ladder and electrical liability falls on the homeowner. They're a reasonable option only for renters or strictly budget-driven buyers.
